summary: Write short, succinct sentences and avoid filler phrases like 'as has been said before', 'each and every', 'point in time' and 'in order to'.
questions: Which wordy phrases should I avoid in docs?

answer_card.title: Avoid verbosity
answer_card.answer_md: Keep sentences short. Avoid filler such as "as has been said before", "each and every", "point in time" and "in order to".
